messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a partner ingestion pipeline that logged an encrypted Vault payload and some base64 blobs to our partner-raw-logs bucket. Notified partner, but we need quick containment + rotation plan. secbot flagged a spike in vault-access errors 15m ago.

devin: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the example log line (redacted) and the S3/GCS object path? we need to confirm if the wrapped ciphertext leaked or plaintext. :eyes: 

maria: log snippet (redacted):
```
2026-03-23T18:12:09Z INFO ingest: payload="vault:v1:wrapped:eyJhbGci..." source=partner-webhook id=abc123
```
path: gs://partner-raw-logs/2026-03-23/partner-webhook/obj_abc123.json

alex: Looks like Vault transit wrapped ciphertext, not plaintext creds, but we must treat as potentially sensitive. Two immediate asks: 1) Revoke any one-time unwrap tokens and 2) start rotation for affected service accounts.

jordan_sre: Oncall will pause the pipeline ingest to that bucket. I'm taking it now. pausing via: `gcloud pubsub subscriptions update ingest-pull --ack-deadline-seconds=600 --push-endpoint=disabled` — will confirm when paused.

secbot: automated-alert: vault-access-spike detected - 28 failed unwraps for key=transit/team-key between 18:00-18:15 UTC. Possible replay attempts.

olivia: For RBAC: we should restrict which service accounts can call transit/decrypt. Proposal: create a short-lived role vault/transit-decrypter with condition limiting source IP and attestation, then grant only partner-ingest-svcacc for 24h while we rotate. Also enable vault audit to push to internal auditstore with retention 90d.

sam_platsec: Agreed. Steps I propose (short checklist):
- contain: pause partner ingest + snapshot bucket and copy to quarantine (gsutil cp -> quarantine-bucket)
- assess: grep for any plaintext patterns across bucket (creds, jwt, pkcs1), report count
- revoke: rotate transit keys (Vault transit rotate-key team-key) and revoke any ephemeral unwrap tokens
- rotate: kick off service account key rotation for partner-ingest-svcacc and internal downstream svcaccs; rotate DB creds if any mapping exists
- audit: enable detailed audit logging on vault/transit and push to SIEM, tag events with incident-id
- RBAC: apply least privilege on kms/vault unwrap APIs + implement conditional constraints

devin: For rotation commands — example Vault CLI we'll run: 
```
vault write -force transit/keys/team-key/rotate
vault token revoke -prefix partner-unwrap-tokens-
```
Note: rotating transit key will not decrypt already-wrapped ciphertext; we must also call `vault transit/rewrap` for objects we can rewrap under new key material if needed, or ask partner to rewrap client-side.

alex: Also check KMS integration points: some downstream systems use GCP KMS to wrap symmetric material that Vault manages. We need to enumerate any cross-wrap relationships. I'm listing owners for that: @olivia to own enumeration, @devin to run quick scan, @maria to coordinate with partner.

maria: Partner confirmed they retained the wrapped payload only and do NOT have unwrap privileges (they never had the transit key). Good. They will stop retention and help re-request tokens after we rotate.

jordan_sre: Pipeline paused. I copied objects to gs://incident-quarantine/1765554321/ and gave read-only to sec team.

sam_platsec: Can we get a short-lived audit link? I want to pull all vault audit events for key=team-key between 17:50-18:20 UTC.

secbot: query-result: 34 audit events found. Sample: `2026-03-23T18:03:14Z auth.method=token path=transit/decrypt key=team-key accessor=... status=403`

devin: I'm going to create a one-off policy lock that denies `transit/decrypt` for `partner-ingest-svcacc` until rotation completes: 
```
policy "temp-deny-partner" {
  path "transit/decrypt" {
    capabilities = ["deny"]
  }
}
vault write auth/gcp/role/temp-deny policies=temp-deny-partner bound_service_accounts=partner-ingest-svcacc
```
This will be applied for 24h.

olivia: Also enable KMS audit forwarding for GCP KMS keys used by platform so we get correlate logs. We should add a SIEM tag `incident:1765554321` to all artifacts.

sam_platsec: Owners and actions:
- maria: partner coordination + paste redacted logs to ticket #INC-1765554321
- devin: apply temp deny policy + run rewrap plan (ETA 2h)
- olivia: enumerate cross-wraps and enable KMS audit forwarding (ETA 3h)
- jordan_sre: pipeline paused + quarantine copy (done)
- alex: confirm downstream systems and DB mappings (ETA 1.5h)
- secteam: run forensics on quarantine objects for any plaintext exposures (ETA 2h)

maria: I'll file the incident ticket and request partner to delete retained objects. tagging @legal for any contract exposure.

alex: One more: add a postmortem checklist item to validate our logging filters so wrapped payloads are not accidentally stored in partner logs in future. Maybe a lint rule for webhook handlers that checks for `vault:` prefixes.

devin: I'll send a quick PR template with a linter rule: `deny_logging_sensitive_wrapped_payloads` and run it through devex.

sam_platsec: Good. We'll reconvene in 45m in #eng-security if anything changes. :lock:
